book.name: LUUKA
book.title: oMwazi Mwinja gwa Yeesu Krisitu nk'oku LUUKA aguyandikaga

content: Ogufuuka kwa Yeesu
Olusiku lwakulikiraga eSaabato, bala bakazi baja ebwa shinda eseeziseezi, eyi baheekere amavurha m'amarashi bali barheganyize.
Bashimaana ebaale lyalichingire eshinda lyahirikirwe eburhambi.
Baja mo, aliko barhabonaga omubiri gwa Nnaweerhu Yeesu.
Babeere bali basoomerwa elugulu w'ebyabeere, ho n'aho balume babiri bayambeere emyambalo ebaraganyize babonekana embere zaabo.
Aboola bakazi bayuubaha bweneene, bayeerekeza amalanga maabo oku daho. Aliko aboola balume bababwira ntya: «Girhumire mwashondera ozeene omu bafu?
Arhali hano, afuukire! Muyibuke ebi ababwiraga amango alichiri eGalilaaya oku:
‹Bihemere Mwene oMuntu ahaanwe oku banyabyaaha, abambwe oku musalaaba, anafuuke olusiku lwa gasharhu.›»
Abo bakazi baava bayibuka ebinwa byaage.
Bagaluka gurhenga ebwa shinda, n'ebyoola byooshi babibalira entumwa ekumi na nguma n'abandi bigirizwa.
Aboola bakazi babibaliraga entumwa baliiri: Mariya w'eMagadala, Jaani, Mariya nyina wa Yakobo n'abandi baliiri haguma nabo.
Aliko ebi binwa byabonekana oku meesho m'entumwa nka ntaacho bimalire, barhanabiyemeeraga.
Aliko Petero yeewe ayimanga, alibirhira ebwa shinda. Ayunamire, abona emyenda alizingirwe mo yonyine. Ava achigalukira emwage, eyi asomereerwe ebyabeere.
Yeesu abonekera abigirizwa babiri omu njira ye Emawu
Olo lusiku lo n'olo, babiri omu bigirizwa ba Yeesu baliiri baaja omu gishagala chiyirikwa Emawu. Chaliiri oku bilomeetere byakagera kw'ekumi na chiguma n'eYerusaleema.
Baliiri baganiira oku byooshi byazindaga kugera.
Babeere bali baganiira n'okubazana, Yeesu yenyine abayegeera n'okugenda haguma nabo.
Aliko ameesho maabo maalihubizwe yi barhamumenya.
Yeesu ababaza ntya: «Binwa bichi muli mwaganiira muli kulambagira?» Bayimanga eyi bagwerhe amaganya manene.
Muguma omu bo, oyirikwa Keleopaasi, amubaza ntya: «Ka wooyo wenyine omu balama eYerusaleema werhamenyere ebyabeere mw'ezi siku?»
Yeesu naye abaza bo ntya: «Bichi ebyo?» Bamushubiza ntya: «Ebiyerekeere Yeesu w'eNazareeti, ola waliiri muleebi w'obuhashe omu bijiro n'enderho embere za Nnamahanga n'embere z'olubaga looshi.
Leero, abakulu b'abadaahwa n'abarhegesi beerhu nji bamuhaanire mpu ahanirwe olufu anabambwe oku musalaaba.
Rhwalinihiire oku yeewe ye wali wachungula Israheeli. Aliko leero haguma n'ebyo byooshi, zeene l'olusiku lwa gasharhu gurhenga ebyo bibeere.
Aliko kandi, abakazi baguma nabo b'echigusho cheerhu bali barhushalamize. Bali balamukiire zeene eseeziseezi oku shinda,
aliko barhaali babwene omubiri gwage. Bamaava bayinja kuderha oku babonekeerwe na bamalahika. Abo bamalahika bababwirire oku Yeesu ali mugumaguma.
Beerhu baguma balijiire oku shinda, banabugaanire ebintu nka okw'abakazi babiderhaga. Aliko yeewe, barhamubwene.»
Yeesu aja ababwira ntya: «Mwe bihwinja mwe! N'emirhima yenyu erhayemeerera ho byooshi abaleebi baderhaga!
Ka Krisitu arhaalikwaneene alibuke ntyo y'aja omu bukuuze bwage?»
Yeesu ava abahuguula oku biri omu Mandiko Matagatiifu mooshi elugulu waage, gurhonderera oku bitaabu bya Muusa n'ebyabaleebi booshi.
Babeere bayegeera egishagala baliiri baaja mo, Yeesu abonekana nk'owagendeerera n'olugenzi.
Aliko bamurhebeereza omu kuderha ntya: «Obeere haguma neerhu, kwenge bwayirire.» Ntyo ku Yeesu ajiire omu nju kubeera haguma nabo.
Abeere ayikala kulya haguma nabo, arhoola omugati
n'okugugisha, aguchagulanga n'okuguheereza bo.
Ameesho maabo maaja mahumuulwa bwinja, baanaja bamumenya. Aliko ahirima embere zaabo.
Baabazana ntya: «K'emirhima yeerhu erhaliyunviirhe obushagaluke bunene amango aliiri aganiira neerhu omu njira n'ogurhuhuguulira eby'aMandiko Matagatiifu maderhere?»
Ho n'aho bayuumuka, bagaluka eYerusaleema. Babugaana zilaala ntumwa ekumi na nguma zichigushire haguma n'abandi bigirizwa.
Abo booshi, babwira bala bigirizwa babiri ntya: «Okuli Nnaweerhu afuukire, anabonekeere Simooni!»
Bala bigirizwa babiri baabala ebyaali bibahikiire omu njira, na gurhe barhegeeraga Yeesu amango achagulangaga omugati.
Yeesu abonekera abigirizwa
Bala bigirizwa babiri babeere bali baderha ebyoola, Yeesu yenyine achiyeerekana ahagarhi kaabo n'okubabwira ntya: «Omurhuula gube haguma nenyu!»
Abigirizwa baashalama n'okuyuubaha bweneene, eyi bakengereere mpu babwene omuzimu.
Aliko Yeesu ababwira ntya: «Bichi birhumire mwayuubaha? Bichi birhumire mwaganganwa omu mirhima yenyu?
Mulole amaboko maani n'amagulu maani, okuli nyoono! Munmamaarhe munaloleereze. Omuzimu arhajira munyofu changwa egufa, nka kunoola mubwene mbigwerhe.»
Omu kuderha ebyoola, abayeereka amaboko maage n'amagulu maage.
Abigirizwa basoomerwa n'ogushagaluka bweneene, n'obo babaaga barhaza kuyemeera echi babwene. Yeesu aja ababaza ntya: «Ka mugwerhe hano echintu ch'okulya?»
Baamuha egichiira ch'efi eyoosezwe.
Agirhoola n'oguchilya embere zaabo.

Aja ababwira ntya: «Ebiila binababwiraga amango nali nchiri haguma nenyu. Byaalihemere bijirike byooshi byaali biyandikirwe elugulu waani omu Rhegeko lya Muusa, omu bitaabu abaleebi bayandikaga n'omu gitaabu ch'eNanga.»
Ho n'aho, Yeesu abahunuula obwenge b'okuyunva aMandiko Matagatiifu.
Ava ababwira ntya: «Biyandikirwe oku Krisitu alibuka, n'oku afuuka omu bafu olusiku lwa gasharhu.
Kandi, omu ziino lyaage, abantu b'ebihugo byooshi gurhangirira eYerusaleema nji baabalirwa oku baleke ebyaaha byaabo yi bababalirwa.
Muli bahamiiriza b'ebyoola byooshi.
Nyoono, nabarhumira echi Daarha alaganyaga. Mwabo, mubeere hanoola Yerusaleema kugera amango mwayankirira obuhashe b'ogurhengera empingu.»
Yeesu aheekwa empingu
Yeesu aheeka abigirizwa baage kugera hoofu n'egishagala ch'eBetaniiya. Ayinamula amaboko elugulu, abagisha.
Abeere ali abagisha, achikuula haguma nabo, aheekwa empingu.
Abigirizwa boowe, bamalire kumuharamya, bagaluka eYerusaleema n'obushagaluke bunene.
Ngasi mango, baliiri omu Nju ya Nnamahanga eyi banali bamukuuza.
